{{Top}}
'''Hibridium''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was found only on the western coastline of the main continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garos IV]]. It was discovered that hibridium had a natural ability to cloak other objects. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], searching for an alternative to [[Stygium/Legends|stygium]] [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]], discovered Garos IV, garrisoned the planet, and strictly regulated the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] of the ore. Unfortunately, the prototype hibridium cloaking devices were far less effective than those created from stygium. They required massive amounts of power to operate, more room to house the device, and left the [[Starship/Legends|craft]] on which they were being used double-blind. Though the craft was invisible to other ships' [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], it could not locate other ships with its own [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Another drawback of these devices was that they became unstable when entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], often resulting in the destruction of the ships on which they were being used.
